title: The Incentive
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the Dunder Mifflin office is challenged to double their sales growth through a new points-based incentive program introduced by Andy, which includes humorous and daring rewards such as getting a tattoo. Meanwhile, Kevin's attempt to communicate with minimal words causes confusion, Dwight introduces the Sabre Pyramid tablet, and Darryl reveals personal developments. The episode also explores interpersonal dynamics, including Andy and Erin's complicated relationship and ethical discussions among coworkers.
